const_gui_text_mapping_rules: Here, you can configure presets specific to this note or deck. You will be able to preview or add audio with a single click of the play/preview buttons on the Anki note editor. You can associate a preset with the Note Type (applies to all notes of that type) or with the Deck And Note Type (only applies to this note type + deck combination)
const_gui_text_source_mode:
Choose a source mode:
Simple: your text comes from a single field. In most cases, choose this option.
Template: text from different fields can be combined together.
Advanced Template: fields can be combined in complex ways using Python.
const_gui_text_source_use_selection: If text is selected in the editor, use that selection instead of the full source field.
const_gui_text_source_advanced_template:
Enter template using Python syntax (advanced users only):
field_1 = template_fields['Field 1']
field_2 = template_fields['Field 2']
result = f'{field_1} {field_2}'
const_gui_text_source_mode_realtime:
Choose a source mode:
AnkiTTSTag: Configure Realtime Audio using Anki {{tts}} tag. You can choose a single field containing the source text. Will use Super Free TTS when reviewing on desktop and fallback to other voices on iOS AnkiMobile.
const_gui_text_source_field_type_realtim:
Field Type:
Regular: the field should be pronounced in its entirety.
Cloze: only use this for cloze fields. The audio on the front will contain everything except for the hidden word, and the audio on the back will contain everything.
ClozeOnly: only use this for cloze fields. Only the hidden word will be pronounced.
